nodes.html: 空间与速度假设数据 · 同一计算结果
nodes.script: const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg',axes=document.getElementById('axes'),points=document.getElementById('points');const add=(tag,attrs,text,parent)=>{const el=document.createElementNS(NS,tag);for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(attrs))el.setAttribute(k,v);if(text!==undefined)el.textContent=text;parent.append(el);return el};for(const value of[0,60,120,180]){const y=250-value/180*216;add('line',{x1:65,x2:570,y1:y,y2:y,class:'grid'},undefined,axes);add('text',{x:54,y:y+4,'text-anchor':'end',class:'tick'},value,axes)}for(const value of[0,8,16,24,32])add('text',{x:65+value/32*505,y:272,'text-anchor':'middle',class:'tick'},value,axes);DSHUI.subscribe(s=>{points.replaceChildren();for(const row of s.derived.series){const x=65+row.memory/32*505,y=250-row.speed/180*216;const circle=add('circle',{cx:x,cy:y,r:7,class:'dot'},undefined,points);add('title',{},row.name+': '+row.memory+' GiB, '+row.speed+' tokens/s',circle);add('text',{x:x+11,y:y-11,class:'value'},row.name+' · '+row.speed,points)}});
